title: Putting On the New Self
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Putting on the new self means living out the new identity God gives believers in Christ. Those made new are called to practice Christlike character, holiness, truth, love, and obedience.
summary: Putting on the new self means living out the new identity God gives believers in Christ. Those made new are called to practice Christlike character, holiness, truth, love, and obedience.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the pattern and power of the new life. Believers put on the new self because they have been made new in Him and are being renewed according to His image.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Christian life is not only putting off sin; it is also putting on what belongs to Christ. God gives His people a new identity and calls them to live according to that new reality.

The new self is marked by truth, righteousness, holiness, compassion, kindness, humility, patience, forgiveness, love, and obedience. These qualities are not costumes for religious appearance, but the fruit of new life.

Putting on the new self requires intentional practice. Believers learn to respond differently because they belong to Christ. They do not merely stop old behaviors; they walk in new ways that reflect Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some people think change only means avoiding certain sins. But God’s purpose is fuller: He forms His people into the image of Christ.

This doctrine helps believers pursue positive holiness. The Lord is not merely removing what is corrupt; He is forming what is beautiful and Christlike.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Practice the new life God has given you. Put on truth where you once practiced deception, mercy where bitterness ruled, humility where pride stood, and love where selfishness reigned. Ask Christ to make your daily conduct match your new identity in Him.
